issues.text: Robots list: the 3-column grid of cards is very tall, so the robots R-03, R-02 and R-01 are cut off at the bottom of the viewport. Many near-empty progress bars waste space.
Small, light-gray secondary text (KPI captions, 'Pour atteindre…', filter chips, table cells) is hard to read at 1280/1440.
Cards in the same row have different heights and internal alignment: R-03 has a stacked badge, a ring and a long description, so its sub-system rows don't line up with R-02 and R-01.
The score ring shows 0 for R-03, R-02 and R-01 yet the scores are 50+. In the first screenshot R-06 shows 4 while the second shows 6, and the average is 45 in both, so the numbers are inconsistent.
Fiche robot: the main score (50/100) appears only in the subtitle, with no large number. The critical banner and the many tables compete with each other.
Fiche robot at 1280: the page content is narrow with large side margins. The sub-assemblies table truncates 'Ce qui bloque' with an ellipsis.

critic.summary: A realistic, coherent workshop dashboard with clear states and good domain detail. It is let down by the ring scores showing 0 or inconsistent values, tall cards that get cut off, small low-contrast text and truncated table cells.
